title: Pan-Seared Duck Legs with Mediterranean Flair
description: Satisfy your nighttime craving with this flavorful, pan-seared duck legs dish infused with the essence of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Rinse the duck legs and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the duck legs with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck legs for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 15-20 minutes, until the duck is cooked through.
While the duck is cooking, mix the minced garlic, chopped rosemary, lemon juice, and honey in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the garlic-herb mixture over the duck legs.
Return the skillet to the oven and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the glaze is caramelized.
Let the duck rest for 5 minutes before serving.
